applies_why: This judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by treating the sign itself as needing to state the mechanism, which is a verse-level stating test within K-C's chain-against-chain setting.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words — reading 1: a single verse must itself state the mechanism or the link is underdetermined; reading 2: the link is weighed by its chain footing, and no single verse need state the point in its own words.
why: Because the judge marks the link underdetermined by saying the sign itself does not state the mechanism, it applies the retired stating-verse/verse-by-verse test instead of weighing chain against chain by footing.
